sources.slope_deg: Computed by TwinWorlds from NASA PDS MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd, resampled to 5.55 km pixels (same spacing as Earth), mean per 1 deg cell
sources.relief_55km_m: Computed by TwinWorlds from MOLA: std dev of 5.55 km elevation within each 1 deg cell (~59 km at the equator)
sources.albedo: MGS TES Lambert albedo, USGS Astrogeology global mosaic (7410 m), mean per 1 deg cell
